name: lsimons-template-workspace
comment:vite: vite is an *optional peer* of vitest, so pnpm auto-installs it and
neither `pnpm update` nor dependabot can see or bump it — the lock
sat on a version with GHSA-fx2h-pf6j-xcff and GHSA-v6wh-96g9-6wx3
with no way to move it. Declaring it explicitly makes it a managed
pin. Keep the range inside vitest's peer range (^8.0.0 today).
